# JiivaaKart — Boutique Fashion & Ethnic Wear Marketplace

> JiivaaKart (JiivaaKart Private Limited) is an Indian online fashion marketplace that connects shoppers across India directly with verified local boutiques, designer studios, and regional artisan craft creators. Tagline: "Style That Speaks".

## Key Business Facts & Consumer Guarantees
- **Legal Entity**: JiivaaKart Private Limited
- **Official Domain**: https://jiivaakart.com
- **Headquarters**: Fatehabad, Haryana - 125050, India
- **Customer Support**: helpdesk@jiivaakart.com | +91-9053883125
- **Operating Regions**: Nationwide India (covering 28,000+ postal pincodes)
- **Nationwide Logistics**: Powered by Shiprocket insured express couriers
- **Free Shipping Threshold**: Free delivery on all orders above ₹499
- **Return & Exchange Policy**: 7-Day Buyer Protection guarantee on all eligible apparel
- **Payment Methods**: 100% Secure Prepaid (UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, NetBanking via Razorpay) and Cash on Delivery (COD)
- **Authenticity Standard**: 100% genuine local boutique merchandise; strict zero-tolerance counterfeit prevention policy

## Core Shopping Hubs
- [Homepage](https://jiivaakart.com): Official marketplace portal featuring trending boutique collections, verified sellers, and new arrivals.
- [Marketplace Catalog](https://jiivaakart.com/shop): Browse multi-vendor collections across women's ethnic wear, sarees, lehengas, kurtis, and men's apparel.
- [Women's Ethnic Wear](https://jiivaakart.com/category/women): Handcrafted designer sarees, festive lehengas, anarkalis, daily kurtis, and bridal couture.
- [Men's Fashion](https://jiivaakart.com/category/men): Casual cotton shirts, ethnic kurtas, formal wear, and seasonal topwear.
- [Kids' Collection](https://jiivaakart.com/category/kids): Festive wear, ethnic outfits, and comfortable everyday wear for children.
- [Merchant Partner Onboarding](https://jiivaakart.com/become-seller): Official onboarding portal for verified Indian boutique owners to sell online.

- [Cancellation Policy](https://jiivaakart.com/cancellation-policy): Pre-dispatch order cancellation terms.
- [Seller Agreement](https://jiivaakart.com/seller-agreement): Terms, commissions, and compliance rules for merchant partners.
